body.zh-Hant: 利奧泰1854年11月17日生於南錫，1873年進聖西爾軍校，1876年再入參謀應用學校。1894年他被派往印度支那，擔任加列尼上校的參謀長，參與上東京的遠征。1897年3月他在馬達加斯加與加列尼重逢，受命綏靖該島西北部與西部，再組織南部。
body.en: Lyautey was born in Nancy on 17 November 1854, entered Saint-Cyr in 1873 and the staff application school in 1876. In 1894 he was sent to Indochina as chief of staff to Colonel Gallieni and took part in the expeditions of upper Tonkin. In March 1897 he rejoined Gallieni in Madagascar, who charged him with pacifying the north-west and west of the island, then organising the south.

heading.zh-Hant: 阿爾及利亞—摩洛哥邊境

body.zh-Hant: 1903年他被阿爾及利亞總督召往南奧蘭，1906年底統率奧蘭師，1907年升為師級將領，翌年出任政府駐烏季達摩洛哥占領區高級專員。在邊境地帶他設立新哨所，一方面確保地區安全，一方面為進入摩洛哥開路。邊境平定後，他於1910年返回法國，出掌第十軍。
body.en: Called to the Sud-Oranais in 1903, he took over the Oran division at the end of 1906, became a divisional general in 1907 and the next year high commissioner for the occupied Moroccan zone around Oujda. On the frontier he built new posts to secure the region and to open the way into Morocco. After the border region was pacified he returned to France in 1910 to take over the 10th Army Corps.

heading.zh-Hant: 摩洛哥保護國與非斯戰事
heading.en: The Moroccan protectorate and the Fès campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1912年3月，非斯條約確立法國對摩洛哥的保護國地位，利奧泰於4月28日成為駐節總督（commissaire résident général）。他5月中旬抵達卡薩布蘭卡後趕赴被柏柏爾首領圍困的非斯，經激戰才恢復該城與周邊的和平。1914年5月，通往阿爾及利亞的要地塔扎被佔領。
body.en: In March 1912 the Treaty of Fès established the French protectorate over Morocco, and on 28 April Lyautey became commissioner resident general. Arriving at Casablanca in mid-May he hurried to Fès, besieged by Berber chiefs, and after violent fighting peace was restored in the city and its region. In May 1914 Taza, the key town on the access to Algeria, was occupied.

heading.zh-Hant: 大戰、陸軍部與里夫戰爭
heading.en: The war, the War Ministry and the Rif war

body.zh-Hant: 1916年12月至1917年3月，他在白里安內閣短暫擔任陸軍部長，其後回到摩洛哥。1921年他晉升法國元帥。1925年春，阿卜杜勒·克里姆發動進攻，威脅塔扎與非斯地區，利奧泰隨即組織防線等待援軍。他在作戰指導上與政府意見相左並被否定，同年10月永久返回法國。
body.en: From December 1916 to March 1917 he briefly served as Minister of War in the Briand cabinet, then returned to Morocco. In 1921 he was raised to Marshal of France. In spring 1925 Abd el-Krim attacked, threatening the Taza and Fès sectors, and Lyautey at once organised a defensive barrage to await reinforcements. He opposed the government over the conduct of operations, was disavowed, and returned to France for good in October.

body.zh-Hant: 1912年10月31日他當選法蘭西學術院院士。1927至1931年他負責最後一項任務，籌辦萬森國際殖民地博覽會。1934年7月27日去世，遺體1961年由拉巴特遷回，葬於榮軍院。
body.en: He was elected to the Académie française on 31 October 1912. From 1927 to 1931 he carried out a last mission, organising the international colonial exposition at Vincennes. He died on 27 July 1934; his remains were brought back in 1961 and buried at the Invalides.

body.zh-Hant: 加列尼1849年4月24日生於聖貝亞，1868年進聖西爾，1870年任少尉。普法戰爭中他被俘，1871年3月12日獲釋。1880年3月29日他經巴富拉貝條約為法國建立在馬里地區的保護關係；1886年5月赴蘇丹並被任命為最高指揮官。1892年9月至1896年8月他在東京（北越）從事綏靖，由利奧泰輔佐。
body.en: Gallieni was born at Saint-Béat on 24 April 1849, entered Saint-Cyr in 1868 and became a sub-lieutenant in 1870. Captured in the Franco-Prussian War, he was freed on 12 March 1871. On 29 March 1880 he established the French protectorate over Mali through the Treaty of Bafoulabé; in May 1886 he went to the Sudan as commandant supérieur. From September 1892 to August 1896 he led pacification campaigns in Tonkin, assisted by Lyautey.

body.zh-Hant: 1896年他晉升准將，應殖民地部長勒邦之請被派往馬達加斯加，9月出任總督。他迫使拉瓦納洛三世女王退位，並推行島上的經濟開發計畫。1899年升少將，1900年6月重返馬島；1903年任東非軍團總司令，兩年後返法並辭去總督職務。
body.en: Promoted brigadier general in 1896, he was sent to Madagascar at the request of Colonial Minister Lebon and became governor-general in September. He forced Queen Ravanalo III to abdicate and carried out an economic development programme for the island. Promoted major general in 1899, he returned to Madagascar in June 1900; made commander in chief of the East Africa troops in 1903, he left the governorship two years later.

body.en: In June 1906 he became military governor of Lyon, heading the 14th Army Corps. Elected to the Supreme Council of National Defence in 1911, he left to Joffre the chance to become commander in chief.

heading.en: The entrenched camp of Paris and the Marne

body.zh-Hant: 1914年4月他因年齡屆限退役，8月26日被維維亞尼政府召回，統率巴黎營壘區各軍。9月2日他獲得民事與軍事全權，下令徵用各式車輛及巴黎計程車，這些計程車在這場反攻戰役中扮演決定性角色。9月8日莫努里重新聽命於霞飛，但加列尼11月仍保有對巴黎的權威，12月7日解散其民事內閣。
body.en: Reaching the age limit in April 1914 he retired, but on 26 August he was recalled to command the entrenched camp of Paris. On 2 September he received full civil and military powers and requisitioned vehicles, including Paris taxis, which played a decisive role in the counter-offensive. On 8 September Maunoury returned under Joffre, but Gallieni kept his authority over Paris through November and dissolved his civil cabinet on 7 December.

body.zh-Hant: 白里安於1915年10月29日提議由他出任陸軍部長；12月2日設立全軍總司令職位並交給他。他的高層指揮改革提議被總理否決，1916年3月7日起三天後以健康為由辭職。1916年5月27至28日夜間他在凡爾賽逝世，1921年5月6日被追贈法國元帥。
body.en: Briand offered him the War portfolio on 29 October 1915; on 2 December the post of commander in chief of all armies was created and entrusted to him. His proposal to reform the high command was disavowed by the premier, and three days after 7 March 1916 he resigned for health reasons. He died at Versailles in the night of 27–28 May 1916 and was made Marshal of France posthumously on 6 May 1921.

body.zh-Hant: 芒然生於摩澤爾省薩爾堡，1866至1925年在世。他率塞內加爾步兵參加1898至1900年的剛果—尼羅河使命，受馬爾尚指揮。他在摩洛哥隨利奧泰擔任上校時攻佔了馬拉喀什。他深信塞內加爾部隊的價值，是更龐大強大的非洲軍（「黑色兵力」）的熱烈支持者。
body.en: Mangin, born at Sarrebourg (Moselle), lived from 1866 to 1925. He took part, at the head of Senegalese tirailleurs, in the Congo-Nile mission of 1898–1900 under Marchand. As a colonel in Morocco with Lyautey he took Marrakech. Convinced of the value of Senegalese troops, he was an ardent partisan of a larger, stronger African army, the "Force noire".

heading.en: 1914–1916: the frontiers, the Marne and Verdun

body.zh-Hant: 1914至1915年他先後指揮一個步兵旅與一個師（魯昂的第5步兵師），參加邊境戰役、馬恩河與阿圖瓦的戰鬥。1916年5月22日他進攻凡爾登的杜奧蒙堡失敗，之後仍與尼維勒一同指導凡爾登的收復攻勢。
body.en: In 1914–15 he commanded an infantry brigade and then a division (the 5th, from Rouen) in the Battle of the Frontiers, on the Marne and in Artois. On 22 May 1916 his attack on Fort Douaumont at Verdun failed; he then directed the reconquest offensives there alongside Nivelle.

heading.en: 1917–1918: the Chemin des Dames and the Tenth Army

body.zh-Hant: 1917年他在貴婦小徑出任第6集團軍司令，攻勢陷入泥淖後被撤職。1918年他重返前線指揮第10集團軍，7月18日在維萊科特雷發動著名反攻，擊潰敵軍。秋季他在埃納突破德軍戰線，解放蘇瓦松與拉昂。
body.en: In 1917 he was at the Chemin des Dames as head of the Sixth Army; when the attack bogged down he was dismissed. He returned in 1918 to command the Tenth Army, with which he made the famous counter-attack of 18 July at Villers-Cotterêts. In the autumn he broke the German front on the Aisne and liberated Soissons and Laon.

body.zh-Hant: 停戰使他原定在洛林發動的攻勢取消。他在美因茨指揮萊茵軍，1919年10月12日被免除指揮職；1920至1921年赴南美執行任務，返國後任殖民地部隊總監，1925年5月12日在巴黎驟逝。他11月19日進入梅斯，12月11日抵達萊茵河畔的美因茨，並佔領萊茵蘭。
body.en: The armistice cancelled his planned offensive in Lorraine. He commanded the Army of the Rhine at Mainz and was relieved of command on 12 October 1919; sent on mission to South America in 1920–21, he became inspector of colonial troops on his return and died suddenly in Paris on 12 May 1925. He entered Metz on 19 November, reached the Rhine at Mainz on 11 December and occupied the Rhineland.

heading.en: Background and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 吉羅出身巴黎一個阿爾薩斯家庭，1900年自聖西爾軍校畢業後加入法國陸軍。1914年他在吉斯戰役中受傷被俘，8月30日之後在荷蘭相關網絡協助下脫逃。1917年秋，他所在的祖阿夫團在貴婦小徑收復馬爾梅松堡。戰後他應利奧泰之請以上校身分回摩洛哥，並參與1926年5月27日阿卜杜勒·克里姆的投降。
body.en: Giraud came from an Alsatian family settled in Paris and joined the army in 1900 on leaving Saint-Cyr. Wounded and captured at the Battle of Guise on 30 August 1914, he escaped with the help of Dr Frère's network. In autumn 1917 his Zouave regiment retook Fort La Malmaison on the Chemin des Dames. After the war he returned to Morocco as a colonel at Lyautey's request and contributed to Abd el-Krim's surrender on 27 May 1926.

body.zh-Hant: 他1936年升將軍，任第7集團軍司令及最高戰爭委員會成員。1940年5月10日其部隊被派往荷蘭，13日在布雷達遲滯德軍推進。5月19日他在瓦西尼以第9集團軍名義試圖阻擋德軍裝甲師時被俘，關押於德勒斯登附近的柯尼希施泰因城堡。1942年4月17日他在部下將領與英國情報機關協助下逃出。
body.en: Made general in 1936, he commanded the Seventh Army and sat on the Supreme War Council. On 10 May 1940 his units were sent to the Netherlands and delayed the German advance at Breda on 13 May. On 19 May he was captured at Wassigny while trying to stop panzer divisions with the Ninth Army, and was held at Königstein castle near Dresden. On 17 April 1942 he escaped with the help of loyal generals and British intelligence.

body.zh-Hant: 1942年11月他經直布羅陀被送出，與艾森豪威爾會面，保住法軍的指揮權。達爾朗的部下拒絕承認他的權威，12月24日達爾朗遇刺才終結衝突；吉羅隨後接任法屬北非與西非高級專員。
body.en: Smuggled out via Gibraltar in November 1942, he met Eisenhower and kept command of French troops. Admiral Darlan's men refused to recognise his authority until Darlan's assassination on 24 December ended the conflict; Giraud then succeeded as high commissioner of French North and West Africa.

body.zh-Hant: 1943年6月法國民族解放委員會在阿爾及爾成立，吉羅與戴高樂共同擔任主席，但吉羅11月即被免去共同主席。1943年9月13日他派法軍登陸科西嘉支援抵抗者。1944年4月他被迫卸任總司令。1946年6月2日他以共和自由黨名單當選第二屆制憲國民議會議員，1949年3月10日獲軍功勳章，次日去世。
body.en: In June 1943 the French Committee of National Liberation was formed at Algiers with the two generals as co-presidents, but Giraud was soon removed from the co-presidency in November. On 13 September 1943 he sent French troops to support the Corsican resistance by a landing. In April 1944 he was virtually forced to retire as commander in chief. On 2 June 1946 he was elected to the second Constituent Assembly on the Republican Party of Liberty list; he received the Médaille militaire on 10 March 1949 and died the next day.

body.zh-Hant: 達朗1881年生於納拉克、1942年卒於阿爾及爾，1901年自海軍學校畢業。第一次大戰他率領海軍炮兵連作戰。他先後任喬治·萊格斯的辦公室主任（1926至1928年、1929至1934年），是二戰前強化並重組法國海軍的推手。
body.en: Darlan, born at Nérac in 1881 and died at Algiers in 1942, left the naval school in 1901. In the First World War he led a battery of naval gunners. He was director of Georges Leygues's cabinet (1926–28, 1929–34) and the architect of the strengthening and reorganisation of the French navy before the war.

heading.en: Fleet command and head of the navy

body.zh-Hant: 1934至1936年他指揮大西洋艦隊，隨後被任命為海軍總參謀長。1939年他獲「艦隊上將」頭銜，該頭銜為使其與英國第一海務大臣同級而設。1939至1940年他統帥法國海軍部隊。
body.en: He commanded the Atlantic squadron from 1934 to 1936 and was then appointed chief of the general staff of the navy. In 1939 he received the title of admiral of the fleet, created to give him a rank equivalent to Britain's First Sea Lord. In 1939–1940 he was commander in chief of the French naval forces.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年6月16日起他任貝當政府的海軍（商船與軍艦）部長；休戰之際，他下令艦隊自沉而不落入敵手。拉瓦爾於1940年12月被免職後，他成為維琪政府副總理；哥倫比亞百科則寫他1941年2月成為副總理兼外長與貝當的指定繼承人，並是實際的政府首腦。1940年聖誕節與1941年5月12日他兩度會見希特勒，並於5月27日簽署「達朗—瓦爾利蒙」議定書，6月3日被維琪政府否決。1942年4月18日拉瓦爾回到政府，他辭去政府職務，但仍是陸海空軍總司令。
body.en: From 16 June 1940 he was minister of the merchant and military navies in Pétain's government; at the armistice he ordered the fleet to scuttle rather than fall into enemy hands. After Laval's dismissal in December 1940 he became vice-president of the Council; the Columbia Encyclopedia dates his vice-premiership and foreign ministry to February 1941 and calls him the actual head of government. He met Hitler on Christmas 1940 and on 12 May 1941, and on 27 May 1941 signed the Darlan–Warlimont protocol, which Vichy rejected on 3 June. When Laval returned on 18 April 1942 he resigned his government posts but remained commander in chief of the land, sea and air forces.

body.zh-Hant: 1942年11月8日盟軍登陸北非時他在阿爾及爾；10日他與美軍司令部達成停戰，13日下令法軍對軸心國作戰。14日他自稱北非高級專員，並與克拉克將軍在11月22日協議中規範法美關係；12月24日他在阿爾及爾被一名年輕保王派學生刺殺。
body.en: He was in Algiers at the Allied landing of 8 November 1942; on the 10th he concluded an armistice with the American command and on the 13th ordered French forces to fight the Axis. On the 14th he proclaimed himself high commissioner in North Africa, settled Franco-American relations with General Clark by the accords of 22 November, and on 24 December was assassinated at Algiers by a young royalist student.
